cd0c1b229277d194.description: نبحث عن باريستا مبدع وشغوف للانضمام إلى فريقنا وتقديم تجربة قهوة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحضير مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة بجودة عالية، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات التواصل الرائعة، والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق، وشغفاً بعالم القهوة، فنحن ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الفرصة. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تحضير وتزيين مشروبات القهوة المختلفة وفقاً للمعايير المحددة. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وسريعة، والإجابة على استفسارات العملاء. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل والمعدات. * المساعدة في إدارة المخزون وطلب المستلزمات عند الحاجة. * العمل على تطوير مهارات القهوة باستمرار والاطلاع على أحدث الاتجاهات.

cd1e81db0ca02756.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Milling Machine Operator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires an individual with 2-5 years of experience in operating milling machines to produce precision metal components. The role involves working with technical drawings and specifications to ensure high-quality output. Key Responsibilities Operate milling machines to manufacture, shape, and finish metal components in accordance with technical drawings and specifications. Set up machines, select appropriate cutting tools, and adjust machine settings to achieve required dimensions and tolerances. Perform various milling operations, including face milling, slot milling, drilling, and contouring. Read and interpret engineering drawings and machining specifications accurately. Monitor machining operations to ensure dimensional accuracy, product quality, and adherence to production standards. Inspect finished components using precision measuring instruments such as Vernier Calipers and Micrometers. Perform basic machine troubleshooting and routine maintenance while strictly following workplace safety procedures. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in operating milling machines within a manufacturing or industrial setting. A proven track record of working with technical drawings and ensuring product quality is essential for this role. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work within a manufacturing environment, contributing to the production of metal components. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cd2a40e2a56cc9d2.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking an HR System Development Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on enhancing HR operations through continuous improvement initiatives, process optimization, and automation. The specialist will contribute to improving overall performance and service delivery within the HR department. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to support the ongoing enhancement of HR operations. This involves evaluating existing processes, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing targeted optimization strategies. Key activities include executing improvement plans, supporting change and transition management, enabling process automation, and promoting the use of standardized tools and methodologies. Key Responsibilities Support reviews of existing HR processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement. Apply qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to assess process effectiveness. Follow structured methodologies for process assessments, incorporating stakeholder feedback. Support the evaluation of process enhancement impact through systematic performance tracking and reporting. Assist in the design, implementation, and monitoring of HR initiatives to improve operational efficiency and service delivery. Support the development and maintenance of the transition playbook for HR services. Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure effective communication, engagement, and adoption of process changes. Support the identification of automation opportunities and ensure alignment with HR requirements. Work closely with HR Managers and IT to define implementation needs and support solution deployment. Apply systems development tools and methodologies. Role Accountabilities Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures within the defined work area. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in HR system development or process improvement roles. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team dedicated to continuous improvement and operational efficiency within the HR department.

cd3ae3b2561434ed.description: About the Role WSP is seeking an Infrastructure Inspector to join its project supervision team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is open to Saudi Nationals and involves inspecting and monitoring infrastructure construction activities to ensure compliance with project standards and specifications. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily site inspections of infrastructure construction activities. Inspect roads, earthworks, drainage, utilities, ducting, pipelines, and associated civil works. Verify works against approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Monitor excavation, backfilling, compaction, trenching, pipe laying, concrete works, and reinstatement activities. Review and respond to inspection requests, maintaining accurate inspection records. Monitor materials and workmanship to ensure compliance with approved project requirements. Identify non-conforming works and support the issuance and close-out of NCRs and site observations. Coordinate with engineers, contractors, utility authorities, and other disciplines to resolve site issues. Witness field and laboratory testing where required. Monitor contractor progress and report construction or quality concerns to the responsible engineer. Maintain daily inspection reports, photographs, checklists, and other site documentation. Ensure construction activities comply with project health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Must be a Saudi National. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in infrastructure construction and site inspection. Proven experience in roads, utilities, drainage, earthworks, and associated civil infrastructure works. Strong construction supervision and site inspection experience. Consultancy or PMC experience is preferred. Experience on major roads, transportation, utilities, or infrastructure development projects is preferred. GCC/Middle East project experience is preferred. Required Skills Good understanding of drawings, specifications, ITPs, method statements, and construction quality requirements. Knowledge of excavation, backfilling, compaction, drainage, utility installation, and roadworks. Strong communication, reporting, and coordination skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a project supervision team focused on infrastructure development.

cd93632a342df6ad.description: About Napco National Napco National is seeking a Production Operator to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Summary The Production Operator is responsible for the proper operation of assigned machinery and ensuring production processes run smoothly. This role involves monitoring the finishing process, performing minor adjustments, and maintaining a clean work environment. Key Responsibilities Operate assigned machinery efficiently and safely. Prepare box identification for products. Complete and submit production reports accurately. Monitor the finishing process continuously and make minor modifications to meet required specifications. Troubleshoot operational problems and report major issues to the shift supervisor. Provide quality control with necessary samples. Ensure the machine and premises are clean at all times by adhering to the machine cleaning schedule. Propose methods for machine improvement to the team leader. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a production or manufacturing environment. Ability to operate machinery effectively. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow procedures. Work Environment This full-time role is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, and involves working in a production facility. The successful candidate will be part of a team dedicated to maintaining efficient and high-quality production standards. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cd42d90d3604ce8a.description: About the Role Talent Diamond is seeking an Occupational Health and Safety Trainer on behalf of a prominent training center located in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves delivering comprehensive safety programs to individuals and corporate employees. The trainer will utilize practical examples that are directly relevant to workplace risks across various industries. Key Responsibilities Deliver occupational health and safety training programs to diverse audiences, including individuals and company employees. Incorporate practical, real-world examples to illustrate workplace risks and safety measures. Cover a range of course topics such as hazard identification, risk assessment, and personal protective equipment. Instruct on workplace safety procedures, fire prevention, emergency response, and evacuation practices. Adapt training content to suit the specific needs and risks of different industries, including construction, industrial, hospitality, and office environments. Required Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience in occupational safety. Appropriate qualifications relevant to the subjects taught. Applicants should specify recognized qualifications and the courses they are certified to deliver. Specialist knowledge in areas such as construction, industrial, hospitality, or office safety is highly valued. Required Skills Strong practical teaching and demonstration abilities. Ability to effectively adapt training methodologies and content for various industries and learning styles. Application Information Candidates from all locations are encouraged to apply. Please include your current location, preferred delivery languages, specific qualifications, and availability for in-person delivery in Jeddah, online delivery, or both, in your application.

cd2722a06fab5769.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Captain to join its team in Medina. This full-time role involves overseeing service operations within banquet rooms, restaurants, and coffee breaks, ensuring high standards of presentation and guest satisfaction. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Communicate service needs to chefs and stewards during functions. Total charges for group functions and present checks to group contacts for payment. Ensure banquet rooms, restaurants, and coffee breaks are prepared for service. Verify proper centerpieces are displayed on all tables. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver before use. Check in with guests to ensure satisfaction with service. Set tables according to event type and service standards. Communicate additional meal requirements, allergies, dietary needs, and special requests to the kitchen. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Communicate using clear and professional language, and answer telephones with appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting team goals and responding to concerns. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods of time. Experience and Training 2-5 years of experience in a similar role. Completion of safety training and certifications as required. About the Team Joining the Sheraton family means becoming part of a global community that has fostered connections since 1937. Associates at Sheraton contribute to a sense of belonging in over 400 communities worldwide by engaging guests through thoughtful service. As part of Sheraton Hotels & Resorts, you will be a member of the Marriott International portfolio of brands, where the focus is on enabling individuals to perform their best work and contribute to a global team.

cd435ebf94c758b1.description: موظف/ـة استقبال ضيوف - مطعم راقٍ نبذة عن الوظيفة: المسؤول عن استقبال الضيوف والترحيب بهم، وإدارة الحجوزات وتنظيم منطقة الاستقبال بما يضمن تقديم تجربة مميزة واحترافية تعكس مستوى المطعم الراقي. المسؤوليات: استقبال الضيوف والترحيب بهم بأسلوب احترافي. إدارة الحجوزات وقوائم الانتظار. تنظيم وتنسيق توزيع الطاولات. الرد على استفسارات الضيوف وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لضمان جودة الخدمة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة الاستقبال. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل وخدمة عملاء ممتازة. مظهر احترافي وأسلوب لبق في التعامل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحت الضغط. المرونة للعمل بنظام الشفتات. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية تعد ميزة إضافية.

cdc3f61b1f4cca64.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Attendant-Housekeeping to join their team in Medina, Central Area District. This is a full-time position focused on maintaining the cleanliness and order of guest rooms and public areas within the hotel, ensuring a comfortable and professional environment for guests. Key Responsibilities Respond promptly to requests from guests and other departments. Fill carts with supplies and transport them to assigned areas. Enter guest rooms following established procedures, ensuring vacancy before entry. Replace guest amenities and supplies, and change dirty linens and terry with clean items. Make beds, fold terry, and clean bathrooms. Remove trash, dirty linen, and room service items. Verify that all in-room appliances are present and in working order. Straighten desk items, furniture, and appliances. Dust, polish, and remove marks from walls and furnishings. Vacuum carpets and perform floor care duties in guest rooms and hallways. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, and assist individuals with disabilities. Communicate professionally and clearly with guests and team members. Support the team in achieving common goals and ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Safety and Security Compliance Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures. Report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Complete required safety training and certifications. Properly store flammable materials. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance, and in excess of 25 pounds with assistance. Capability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related equipment over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for extended periods across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Professional Conduct Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Medina, within the Central Area District, and involves working within a hotel environment to support guest services and facility maintenance.

cd49ecdcbe82d457.description: نبحث عن أخصائي تسويق وصناعة محتوى يتولى إنتاج المحتوى اليومي وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، والمشاركة في تنفيذ الحملات التسويقية وقياس نتائجها. المهام والمسؤوليات: تخطيط المحتوى وتصوير المنتجات وتجربة العملاء، وكتابة النصوص وتحرير الفيديوهات القصيرة ونشرها. إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي ومتابعة التفاعل وأداء المحتوى. تنفيذ الحملات التسويقية والإعلانات الرقمية ومتابعة نتائجها وفق الخطة والميزانية المعتمدة. التنسيق مع المصورين وصناع المحتوى والجهات التسويقية الخارجية عند التعاقد معهم. اقتراح أفكار لتحسين الوصول والتفاعل وزيارات العملاء، وإعداد تقارير أداء مختصرة.

cd115a453ca9a31f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن مطور تطبيقات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطوير وصيانة حلول التطبيقات لتلبية متطلبات العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فهم خطط تصميم التطبيقات وإعداد خطط مفصلة لكتابة الأكواد البرمجية واختبارها، مع تحديد الأطر الزمنية ومراحل التنفيذ. تطوير الأكواد البرمجية للتطبيقات باستخدام لغات البرمجة المناسبة، وتجميعها في برامج تنفيذية جاهزة للاستخدام. نشر التطبيقات على أجهزة العملاء وتنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى اختبار المنتج وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي لضمان الأداء السليم. توثيق جميع إجراءات تطوير التطبيقات بشكل دقيق لتسهيل التحديثات والتغييرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير التطبيقات. فهم قوي لمبادئ تصميم وتطوير البرمجيات. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتلبية متطلبات العملاء وتقديم حلول تطبيقية عالية الجودة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

cd171371a69933cd.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs transport solutions and partners with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems. The Group operates in over 80 countries, supporting clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. The Role of Resident Engineer (Tracks) SYSTRA is seeking a Resident Engineer (Tracks) to lead onsite delivery for the Tracks package within a major rail/metro program in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Operating under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) scope, the Resident Engineer will work alongside the client and contractors to oversee construction quality, safety, progress, interfaces, and compliance with contract and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead site supervision for civil and track works, including earthworks, subgrade, structures (viaducts, bridges, tunnels where applicable), ballast/ballastless track, sleepers, rail installation, welding, grinding, fastening systems, drainage, and ancillary works. Enforce HSE standards and safety culture; chair toolbox and coordination meetings; ensure compliance with method statements, risk assessments, and permit-to-work systems. Monitor construction quality against IFC drawings, specifications, ITPs, and QMS; witness inspections, approve/reject work, and close NCRs and punch lists. Oversee progress against approved schedules and look-aheads; validate productivity, resources, and access possessions; identify risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans. Manage interfaces with utilities, stations/depot, systems (signaling, OCS/3rd rail, telecoms), and T&C teams; facilitate access, logistics, and sequencing to protect critical path. Review and approve contractor method statements, shop drawings, materials submittals, and temporary works designs in coordination with design and client engineers. Administer the contract at site level in line with PMC/client procedures and relevant forms (*, FIDIC); manage correspondence, engineer’s instructions, and change control inputs. Validate contractor progress measurement, verify quantities for interim payments, and provide substantiation for approvals. Support time and cost assessments, claims analysis inputs, and time-impact reviews in collaboration with planning and commercial teams. Ensure as-built records, redlining, and documentation are maintained; support handover readiness, commissioning interfaces, and final completion. Lead and mentor site inspection teams (civil, track, materials testing); drive skills transfer and continuous improvement. Required Skills and Experience Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated site leadership with effective communication and stakeholder management abilities. Rigorous attention to safety, quality, and compliance standards. Strong problem-solving, risk identification, and mitigation skills, particularly under schedule pressure. Clear, structured reporting and documentation discipline.

cd43ebf16b8e3873.description: About the Role Aloula Aviation is seeking a Cyber Security Specialist to join their team in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the development and implementation of various cybersecurity functions, including standards, assessments, identity and access management, and incident response. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Cybersecurity standards and procedures. Conduct various cybersecurity assessments and reviews, such as Maturity Assessments, Risk Assessment, Compliance Assessments, Vulnerability Assessments, Social Engineering Assessments, and Penetration Testing. Protect data and information systems against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction. Monitor and control access to information assets. Support the development of cybersecurity metrics and track the company's cybersecurity performance. Implement cybersecurity awareness programs and conduct awareness training. Support incident management and response, including investigation and forensics. Cybersecurity Focus Areas The specialist will contribute to several critical areas of cybersecurity, including vulnerability management, patch management, network monitoring, security architecture, and cyber threat intelligence. This involves a comprehensive approach to maintaining and enhancing the organization's security posture. Required Experience and Skills A minimum of 12 years of work experience in the cybersecurity field. Preferred Qualifications Additional relevant certifications or experience in cybersecurity are preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a dedicated professional to contribute to the ongoing security efforts of Aloula Aviation.

cd9380f1cdc7d683.description: About the Role Data Services Saudi Arabia Limited One Person Company is seeking a Community Engagement Manager for AWS InCommunities. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on leading community-first initiatives to drive positive impact and enhance brand reputation for AWS Infrastructure Data Center Communities in the Middle East and Africa. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary contact for the Community Engagement program for Amazon infrastructure business across the Middle East and Africa. Provide strategic vision and direction for community engagement initiatives throughout the region. Manage the development of partnerships with local stakeholders and oversee the planning and delivery of community programs and initiatives, ensuring attention to detail and high quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, human resources, legal, public policy, and public relations, to achieve program objectives. Manage community events and encourage Amazon employees to volunteer and participate in these events. Facilitate discussions related to community engagement during planning approvals to support AWS infrastructure expansion. Communicate program impact to stakeholders and share stories internally and externally in partnership with Public Relations and Communications teams. Utilize various communication channels, including newsletters, intranet, social media, and email campaigns, to promote employee awareness and involvement in community engagement initiatives. Capture data to quantify and qualify the impact of community engagements on AWS Infrastructure, its employees, and the community. Oversee the budget and manage expenditures within the scope of control for community engagement activities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in community engagement or a related field. Proven ability to write and speak effectively for diverse audiences. Demonstrated capacity to provide vision for regional community engagement initiatives and manage them with a focus on quality. Experience working with cross-functional teams and providing strategic counsel at all organizational levels. Ability to think and communicate clearly, formulate clear points of view on complex issues, and create concise narratives. A willingness to be physically present in locations within the region and undertake practical work as required. Experience in developing local tactics to deliver regional objectives. Work Environment This role involves working with a variety of external stakeholders, including non-profits, and representing AWS Infrastructure publicly in meetings. The position requires a proactive approach to building relationships and collaborating on impactful outcomes within the community. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

cd469abaa10d61b0.description: About the Role Jodayn is seeking an Information Systems Analyst to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is specifically designated for persons with disabilities, reflecting the company's commitment to workplace inclusion and equal employment opportunities. The role focuses on enhancing operational efficiency and supporting business objectives through the analysis, evaluation, and improvement of information systems and business processes. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing information systems and business processes to identify improvement opportunities. Gather, document, and evaluate business and technical requirements. Monitor system performance and recommend solutions for efficiency and reliability. Coordinate with IT teams and business stakeholders for system enhancements. Prepare system documentation, process flowcharts, user guides, and technical reports. Conduct system testing and support user acceptance testing (UAT). Analyze data and prepare reports to support business decision-making. Identify opportunities for process automation and operational improvement. Troubleshoot system-related issues and coordinate their resolution. Support the implementation, integration, and maintenance of business applications. Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies. Collaborate with colleagues across departments to ensure systems meet business needs. Eligibility and Requirements This position is specifically designated for persons with disabilities. Applicants must be persons with disabilities to be eligible for consideration, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Competencies: Systems Analysis and Evaluation, Data Analysis and Reporting, Business Process Improvement, Problem-Solving and Critical Thinking, Technical Documentation, Attention to Detail, Communication and Collaboration, Organization and Time Management. Performance Indicators (KPIs): Timely completion of assigned system analysis tasks, accuracy and quality of reports and technical documentation, effective identification and resolution of system issues, successful delivery of system improvements, compliance with information security and data protection requirements, and contribution to operational efficiency and continuous improvement. Workplace Inclusion and Accessibility Jodayn is committed to maintaining an inclusive and accessible workplace that respects individual differences and supports professional development. Reasonable accommodations and appropriate workplace adjustments will be considered, where applicable, to enable the successful candidate to perform the essential functions of the role effectively. The company aims to provide an accessible, supportive, and inclusive work environment that enables employees to contribute effectively and develop their professional skills.

cd4a61e8a48f0922.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking an experienced Administrative Assistant (Executive Support) to provide comprehensive administrative support to senior leadership, specifically the Vice President's Office. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the smooth coordination of meetings, schedules, documentation, and daily administrative activities within a professional environment in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting senior executives, organizing leadership meetings, preparing essential meeting materials, and managing confidential documents. The position requires a proactive approach to office coordination and a strong ability to follow up on action items to ensure timely completion. Key Responsibilities Provide administrative and executive support to senior management and the Vice President's Office. Manage calendars, appointments, schedules, and meeting arrangements. Organize and coordinate senior management and leadership meetings. Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and supporting documents. Attend meetings, take minutes, prepare meeting notes, and circulate action points. Follow up with department heads and stakeholders to ensure completion of assigned actions. Handle official correspondence, emails, reports, and confidential documents. Coordinate internal and external communications with senior stakeholders. Arrange business travel, appointments, workshops, and official events. Maintain organized records, files, and administrative documentation. Support special assignments and other administrative activities as required. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant administrative or executive support experience. Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Senior Administrative Assistant, or Management Assistant. Experience supporting Vice Presidents, Directors, CEOs, or other senior executives is highly preferred. Hands-on experience coordinating leadership meetings and preparing meeting documentation. Experience preparing meeting minutes, presentations, reports, and official correspondence. Experience coordinating with multiple departments and senior stakeholders. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

cd4d88b0ffef5161.description: About the Role شركة رفل العقارية is seeking a Real Estate Sales Specialist to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to achieving the company's sales targets by engaging with potential clients, closing sales and leasing deals, and fostering long-term client relationships. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell residential and commercial units within the company's projects. Communicate with potential clients to understand their needs and provide suitable real estate solutions. Organize and conduct field tours for clients at sites and projects. Prepare marketing proposals and contracts, and finalize sales procedures in coordination with the legal department. Update the client database regularly via the CRM system. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets. Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports and submit them to management. Monitor market trends and competitor prices, providing recommendations. Represent the company at real estate events and exhibitions. Coordinate with marketing, legal, and financial departments to ensure smooth sales processes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. At least 2-5 years of experience in real estate sales. Required Skills Strong negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills. Familiarity with the legal and procedural aspects of real estate sales and purchases. Proficiency in using CRM systems and Microsoft Office Suite. Commitment to deadlines, professional communication, and appearance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where you will work as part of a dedicated sales team, collaborating with various internal departments to achieve company objectives. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role to contribute to our sales success.

cd62a1c673682b0c.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Healthcare Finance & Revenue Cycle Specialist to manage financial activities and healthcare insurance claim processes in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires strong experience in both Finance/Accounting and Medical Insurance/Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Role Overview The specialist will be responsible for financial analysis, budgeting, invoice and quotation validation, insurance claims, reconciliation, and reporting. The position involves coordination with healthcare operators, insurance companies, and internal Finance teams to ensure efficient financial operations and revenue cycle performance. Key Responsibilities Review and validate invoices and quotations for accuracy and compliance. Monitor budgets, expenditures, and financial performance. Support annual budget preparation, monitoring, and control. Prepare monthly financial analysis and variance reports. Identify financial discrepancies, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Oversee monthly medical insurance claim submission processes. Review and validate insurance claims for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Monitor claim rejections and denials and support corrective actions. Perform insurance claim reconciliation and resolve discrepancies with operators and insurers. Monitor payment and collection processes and ensure proper documentation. Coordinate with insurance companies and healthcare operators regarding claims and payment issues. Prepare financial and insurance/RCM performance reports for management. Monitor financial and revenue cycle Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Analyze trends and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle performance. Support audits and ensure compliance with applicable policies and requirements. Act as a key contact for Finance and medical insurance/claim-related matters. Coordinate closely with KAUST Health, Finance, healthcare operators, and insurance companies. Participate in reconciliation meetings and follow up on outstanding issues. Support management with financial and operational analysis. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Finance/Accounting and Medical Insurance/Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management. Demonstrated ability to oversee financial activities and manage healthcare insurance claim processes. Strong analytical skills for financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Experience in reconciling insurance claims and resolving discrepancies. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

The company's technology offers role-specific co-pilots for mine and plant operations, or sends recommendations directly to control systems, advancing operations towards autonomy. Headquartered in Cambridge, UK, ********** operates remotely with regional hubs in Chile, Australia, and Ireland, and has a growing presence in Saudi Arabia, a key region for mining development under Vision 2030. The Role: Mining Technology Lead – Plant (Lead Metallurgist, Industrial AI) ************ is seeking a Mining Technology Lead – Plant to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on leading the implementation, commissioning, and value delivery across customer plant sites. The successful candidate will serve as the metallurgical authority for various circuits, ensuring that the company's AI accurately reflects plant behavior and delivers verifiable value. Key Responsibilities Own the implementation, commissioning, and value delivery across all Plant customer sites. Act as the metallurgical authority for crushing, grinding, flotation, leaching, thickening, and other circuits to ensure AI accurately reflects plant behavior. Prove delivered value with sound, data-driven baselines that customers trust, and use these to secure renewals. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Mining Technology Engineers across multiple sites. Collaborate with agentic AI engineers to automate site rollout and service work. Integrate site feedback into the product roadmap. Support account teams in acquiring more sites and products with existing customers. Work Environment and Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. ************ operates as a remote-first company with flexible working arrangements. The position requires the ability to obtain the right to work in Saudi Arabia, and both Saudi nationals and expatriates are encouraged to apply. Onboarding may include a period at the company's UK headquarters. Compensation and Benefits ************ offers a competitive salary and benefits package, benchmarked to the candidate's location. The role provides direct ownership of a market within a growing industrial AI company and an opportunity to shape the company's presence in Saudi Arabia. Application Process The hiring process typically involves a 30-minute call with the People team, a technical interview, a short test project presentation, a conversation with the Chief Customer Officer and Chief Growth Officer, and reference checks. cd75c3b53051e6c3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اسعد عبدالرحمن الاهدل للنقليات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمهام محاسبية أساسية لضمان دقة السجلات المالية والامتثال للمعايير المحاسبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. فهم قوي للمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية والتحليلات الدقيقة. المهارات والكفاءات دقة عالية في التعامل مع البيانات المالية والأرقام. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الوثائق المحاسبية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل جيدة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن مؤسسة اسعد عبدالرحمن الاهدل للنقليات. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال المحاسبة.

cd7c49016aa50783.description: About the Role Solaiman A. ElKhereiji (SAK) Engineering Consultant Company is seeking a Sr. Landscape Architect to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing, reviewing, and coordinating landscape design and site implementation on mega construction projects. The primary objective is to ensure compliance with approved masterplans, detailed drawings, specifications, and project requirements, bridging design intent with site execution. Key Responsibilities Implement landscape designs from concept through construction, ensuring alignment with approved visions, regulations, client requirements, and sustainability goals. Review and validate landscape masterplans, detailed drawings, specifications, calculations, and planting schedules for compliance and constructability. Manage and coordinate landscape work packages across design development and construction stages, proactively resolving site and design issues. Conduct site analyses to assess environmental, cultural, functional, and operational constraints impacting landscape solutions. Coordinate with Architectural, Structural, MEP, Irrigation, BIM, HSE, and QA/QC teams to ensure comprehensive interdisciplinary integration. Review contractor submissions, including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, and samples related to landscape works. Respond to RFIs and provide technical clarifications to support site execution and maintain program alignment. Prepare technical reports, gap analyses, value engineering proposals, and optimization recommendations to enhance performance and constructability. Support CSC inspectors during inspections, snagging, de-snagging, and handover activities. Verify progress, quantities, and milestones related to landscape works and contribute to project reporting and as-built documentation. Design and Technical Control Ensure alignment between IFC drawings, BIM models, and site installations. Identify design clashes and constructability issues, proposing technically sound solutions. Coordinate revisions and ensure timely issuance of updated drawings. Required Experience and Performance Expectations Candidates should possess 10+ years of experience in landscape architecture. Performance will be measured by timely responses to RFIs and design clarifications in line with CSC timelines, effective coordination that minimizes rework, NCRs, and site delays, and the provision of clear, actionable, and technically justified review comments. Coordination and Reporting The Sr. Landscape Architect will report to the Landscape Discipline Lead / Resident Engineer. This role requires coordination with CSC inspectors, PMC, client representatives, and contractors. Adherence to CSC reporting lines, approval authorities, and Aconex protocols is essential. Documentation and Records The role involves the use and preparation of various forms and records, including RFI responses, Shop Drawing Review Forms, MIR / WIR support documentation, Design Review Comments Logs, and Snag Lists and Handover Punch Lists.

cd7eca00a05d1b79.description: About the Role Brunel is seeking a Senior HR Business Partner for industrial areas in Dammam. This full-time role serves as the primary HR partner for Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and HSE functions, focusing on strategic people initiatives and operational support. Key Responsibilities Partner with industrial leaders to align people strategies with operational objectives. Advise managers on organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, staffing, and performance management. Support organizational changes and transformation initiatives within industrial areas. Manage the Global Trainee Program in Industrial settings. Facilitate Talent Review and Succession Planning processes for industrial populations, identifying critical talent and development opportunities. Roll out the annual Performance Management Process (PMP) and coach managers on performance conversations, goal setting, and development planning. Identify capability gaps and workforce development needs, delivering technical, leadership, quality, safety, and operational training programs. Coordinate with the Talent Attraction team to fill operational positions and support selection processes for various personnel. Facilitate internal staffing and mobility opportunities aligned with business needs and employee development. Support the implementation of Employee Opinion Survey (EOS) action plans and promote a positive employee experience. Act as a trusted advisor for employees and managers on workplace matters, providing guidance on employee relations cases and ensuring compliance with labor regulations. Monitor key people indicators such as turnover, absenteeism, succession coverage, and training compliance, generating insights and recommendations for decision-making. cd900dc7f80108e4.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking a Business Integration Manager Water to join its team in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on integrating Water assets into a unified, decision-ready portfolio by connecting performance, governance, stakeholder, risk, compliance, and cost information across Project Companies and enabling functions. The role provides consolidated reporting and consistent narratives to KSA leadership, standardizes governance workflows, and strengthens strategic stakeholder engagement. Key Accountabilities Consolidate Water asset performance into standardized reports and dashboards for various stakeholders, including KSA leadership and committees. Normalize and compare performance indicators across Project Companies and technologies to create a consistent portfolio view. Develop and maintain Water portfolio dashboards, reporting templates, and management narratives. Identify performance deviations and cross-asset issues, coordinate root-cause analysis, and escalate matters requiring leadership intervention. Standardize board and committee structures, calendars, and preparation guidelines across Water Project Companies. Coordinate the preparation, quality review, and timely circulation of governance materials. Track strategic board and committee decisions, commitments, and action items through closure. Maintain stakeholder maps and engagement plans for Water-sector Offtakers, authorities, EPC contractors, and other key partners. Coordinate internal alignment and unified communication before strategic engagements and high-level meetings. Organize periodic strategic business reviews and high-level meetings, including agenda and follow-up actions. Consolidate Water portfolio audit, risk, and compliance information, providing early visibility of systemic exposure. Track mitigation actions and closure of audit and compliance findings, escalating overdue items. Track Service Level Agreement execution, fees, cost allocation, and recovery from SPVs, escalating leakage or delayed recovery. Support resource allocation to improve utilization, cost efficiency, and continuity of Project Company roles. This includes maintaining accurate records, trackers, and source data with clear version control. The manager will identify and implement improvements to reporting, governance, stakeholder coordination, risk visibility, cost recovery, and resource-management processes, promoting technology-enabled and standardized ways of working across the Water portfolio. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in business integration, portfolio management, or a related field within the water sector. A strong understanding of performance reporting, governance frameworks, stakeholder management, risk assessment, and compliance is essential. Communication and Working Relationships This role requires extensive internal collaboration with the Water Assets Head, Head of Business Integration, KSA CEO, Project Companies, EMOs, Finance, P&C, HSSE, Legal, Contracts, Risk, Audit, Compliance, Business Development, Operations, Digital, and Corporate Communications. External relationships include shareholders, Offtakers, government authorities, EPC contractors, OEMs, key suppliers, lenders, advisors, consultants, and strategic partners. Additional Responsibilities The Business Integration Manager Water will perform other related duties or assignments as directed by the line manager within the scope of the role.

This full-time role requires mandatory experience within the Airline/Aviation industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end service delivery, maintaining client relationships, ensuring compliance with SLAs and KPIs, and coordinating technical and operational teams to deliver IT services. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end IT service delivery for clients in the airline/aviation sector. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders. Ensure service delivery adheres to agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Monitor service performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Coordinate with technical, operational, and support teams to resolve service issues. Manage incidents, problems, escalations, and service requests. Ensure effective communication between business stakeholders and technical teams. Support ITIL-based service management processes and best practices. Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical issues. Required Qualifications and Experience Mandatory: Proven experience working within the Airline/Aviation industry. Strong knowledge of IT Service Management / ITIL principles. Experience managing SLAs, KPIs, service performance, and escalations. Strong stakeholder and client management skills. Experience coordinating cross-functional technical and operational teams. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. cdce3af7c7569b07.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Mechatronics Engineer to join the Facility Maintenance team within Mechanical Services Shops in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the reliability, maintainability, and safe operation of integrated mechanical, electrical, control, robotic, and automated systems across the facility. The successful candidate will lead troubleshooting efforts, preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment upgrades, and lifecycle management for facility equipment and production machinery. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement maintenance strategies for facility equipment, including CNC machines, balancing machines, robots, furnaces, test stands, pumps, compressors, conveyors, drives, sensors, and hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, servo, PLC, motion-control, hydraulic, pneumatic, and communication faults using drawings, diagnostic software, measurements, and failure evidence. Establish asset criticality, preventive and predictive maintenance tasks, lubrication, alignment, vibration monitoring, thermography, calibration, spare-parts requirements, and condition-monitoring programs. Engineer and validate equipment upgrades, safety circuits, drives, sensors, automation changes, and OEM retrofits through controlled design, testing, and change management. Maintain CMMS records, maintenance plans, procedures, breakdown reports, KPIs, obsolescence plans, contractor controls, technical documentation, and training for maintenance personnel. Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable safety regulations, operational procedures, equipment standards, and quality requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Electromechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A minimum of 12 years of industrial or facility maintenance experience is required. At least 7 years of this experience must be specifically supporting CNC machines, balancing machines, or integrated mechatronic systems. Required Skills and Knowledge Strong hands-on knowledge of machine mechanics, bearings, alignment, hydraulics, pneumatics, motors, drives, servos, PLCs, sensors, robots, and safety interlocks. Experience with OEM diagnostic tools, electrical and mechanical drawings, precision measurement, condition monitoring, and structured root cause analysis. Demonstrated ability to develop preventive maintenance plans, manage critical spare parts, execute equipment upgrades, and support safe commissioning. Work Environment This role is part of the Facility Maintenance team within Mechanical Services Shops, focusing on maintaining facility infrastructure, industrial machinery, and supporting equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply for this Mechatronics Engineer position.

cdf1ac78f791f347.description: About the Role DAR Engineering is seeking a Head of Hospitality Design to lead its hospitality design practice from the head office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time leadership position is responsible for setting the design direction, standards, and quality for DAR's portfolio, which includes hotels, resorts, and serviced residences. The role is accountable for the growth, reputation, and delivery capability of the practice across Saudi Arabia and the wider region, operating as a head office function not tied to a single project. The successful candidate will demonstrate design excellence combined with commercial and operator awareness. This involves advising senior leadership and clients, supporting business development efforts, and building a high-performing team of architects and interior designers. Key Responsibilities Lead and develop DAR's hospitality design practice, defining its vision, service offering, positioning, and growth strategy in alignment with the company's business plan. Provide design leadership and creative direction for hospitality projects, encompassing hotels, resorts, serviced residences, mixed-use developments with hospitality components, food and beverage, wellness, and leisure, from concept through detailed design. Establish and maintain hospitality design standards, guidelines, templates, and quality assurance processes, ensuring consistent application across all projects. Review key design deliverables at critical stages, offering independent design and technical oversight across the portfolio without being embedded in specific project teams. Maintain a strong working knowledge of international hotel operator brand standards and guest experience requirements, ensuring designs meet operator, owner, and regulatory expectations. Support business development by leading hospitality pursuits, shaping proposals and presentations, developing concepts for bids, and representing DAR in client and operator meetings. Promote sustainability, innovation, and digital design tools in hospitality design, keeping the practice current with guest experience trends. Represent DAR as a thought leader at industry events, awards, and publications to enhance the practice's reputation. Ability to advise senior leadership and clients effectively. Experience in business development support and team building. Work Environment and Benefits This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The selection process typically involves two interview stages, with the initial interview generally conducted virtually and the final stage often taking place in person at the office, tailored to the role's location and candidate needs.

cd033340076b5ec5.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an Associate Director - Destination Partnerships. This full-time role is responsible for developing and managing Qiddiya’s commercial partnerships ecosystem and distribution network. The position focuses on driving sustainable revenue through strategic partnerships, travel trade relationships, online and offline distribution channels, and tourism activations. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead the commercial partnerships and distribution strategy in alignment with Qiddiya’s objectives, national tourism priorities, and Vision 2030. Establish multi-year commercial targets, partnership priorities, and pipeline development plans. Identify, negotiate, and secure high-value partnerships with various travel and hospitality entities. Lead the development and optimization of Qiddiya’s business-to-business and business-to-consumer distribution network.
